name: Notubiz Decision to decidesk Decision
description: Maps a Notubiz besluit/motie (RIS decision on a motion) onto decidesk's unified Decision schema with decisionType=motion. Notubiz status aangenomen/verworpen maps to outcome adopted/rejected. lifecycle is set to decided.

mapping.title: {{ values.title ?? values.name ?? values.subject }}
mapping.outcome: {% set s = (values.result ?? values.status ?? '')|lower %}{% if s == 'aangenomen' or s == 'adopted' or s == 'accepted' %}adopted{% elseif s == 'verworpen' or s == 'rejected' %}rejected{% else %}{% endif %}
